description: This file contains unit tests for the GatewayEndpointID component within the OpenClaw project. It tests the decoding and normalization of network endpoint service names, including handling of Bonjour escape sequences.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointIDTests
classes.description: Test suite for GatewayEndpointID functionality, verifying decoding, normalization, and description of network endpoints.

methods.name: stableIDForServiceDecodesAndNormalizesName
methods.description: Tests that GatewayEndpointID correctly decodes and normalizes service endpoint names with Bonjour escapes.

methods.name: stableIDForNonServiceUsesEndpointDescription
methods.description: Tests that GatewayEndpointID uses the endpoint description for non-service endpoints.

methods.name: prettyDescriptionDecodesBonjourEscapes
methods.description: Tests that the pretty description properly decodes Bonjour escape sequences.
